tenx_dextramer.citation: 10x Genomics Application Note (2019): 'A new way of exploring immunity: linking highly multiplexed antigen recognition to immune repertoire and phenotype' (Cell Ranger 3.0.2 Healthy Donors 1 & 2)
tenx_dextramer.setting: Resting steady-state peripheral blood CD8+ T cells from healthy HLA-typed donors
tenx_dextramer.label_source: 10x Genomics published binarized_matrix.csv (44 viral/cancer pMHC dextramer '*_binder' columns) + raw Antibody Capture UMI counts for 6 negative-control ('*_NC') dextramers and TotalSeq-C CD45RO/CD45RA surface antibodies.
tenx_dextramer.experimental_assay: Simultaneous staining with 50 DNA-barcoded dCODE MHC class I dextramers (44 viral/self epitopes + 6 negative-control peptides) + CITE-seq TotalSeq-C antibodies + 5' scRNA-seq + scTCR-seq.
tenx_dextramer.positive_definition: Paired CDR3ab clonotypes where >=50% of cells in the clone carry the same single-specificity binder call in binarized_matrix.csv (plus >=2 single-binder cells for all expanded >=2-cell evaluations): bona fide viral memory = Influenza A M1 (GILGFVFTL), EBV (BMLF1/BZLF1/EBNA-3A/3B/LMP2A), and CMV pp65 (NLVPMVATV). Sticky reagent A0301_KLGGALQAK_IE-1_CMV is excluded from ground-truth viral positives and evaluated separately as a multimer QC stress test.
tenx_dextramer.negative_definition: (A) Naive antigen-specific precursors: HLA-A*02:01 MART-1 (ELAGIGILTV) dextramer+ clones (verified phenotypically naive via TotalSeq-C CLR(CD45RO) - CLR(CD45RA) < -2.9 and >99% singletons). (B) Unlabeled expanded blood clones: paired CD8 clones (>=2 cells) negative for all 44 panel dextramers (representing memory T cells against unpanelled antigens). (C) Memory subtype contrast: Influenza M1 GILGFVFTL vs EBV expanded clones.
tenx_dextramer.circularity_controls: 10x Genomics dextramer data were ingested into VDJdb (reference containing '10xgenomics'); VDJdb matching reports both unmodified VDJdb (circular) and 10x-study-held-out VDJdb (independent).

minervina_2022.citation: Minervina, Pogorelyy, Kirk et al., Nature Immunology 2022 (23:781-790; DOI:10.1038/s41590-022-01184-4; PMID:35383307)
minervina_2022.setting: Longitudinal human peripheral blood SARS-CoV-2 CD8+ T cells across pre-exposure, convalescence, mRNA vaccination, acute post-dose-2 recall, and breakthrough infection
minervina_2022.gex_vdj_accession: Zenodo 6232103 (libs_aggregate_rev.zip: aggregated Cell Ranger filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 + filtered_contig_annotations.csv)
minervina_2022.label_source: Curated single-cell dextramer & cohort metadata table pogorely/COVID_vax_CD8 (cd8_only_dextr_rev_clean.tsv; columns 'barcode', 'donor', 'epitope', 'spike', 'donor_category', 'sample_category').
minervina_2022.experimental_assay: FACS and DNA-barcoded HLA class I dextramer profiling across 18 SARS-CoV-2 Spike and non-Spike (ORF1ab, N, M, ORF3a) epitopes.
minervina_2022.positive_definition: (1) State recall AUROC: paired-TCR CD8 clones (>=2 cells) sampled during acute post-vaccine dose-2 recall (donor_category == 'inf_after_2'). (2) VDJdb specificity recovery: paired-TCR CD8 clones carrying a curated SARS-CoV-2 epitope call in cd8_only_dextr_rev_clean.tsv.
minervina_2022.negative_definition: State recall AUROC: disjoint paired-TCR SARS-CoV-2 CD8 clones (>=2 cells) sampled during resting post-infection convalescence (donor_category == 'post_inf'), excluding longitudinal clones observed in both categories.
minervina_2022.circularity_controls: PMID:35383307 is indexed in VDJdb; VDJdb matching reports both unmodified VDJdb (circular) and PMID:35383307-held-out VDJdb (independent).

fischer_2021.citation: Fischer, Ansari, Wagner et al., Nature Communications 2021 (12:4515; DOI:10.1038/s41467-021-25548-w; PMID:34301934)
fischer_2021.setting: Paired unstimulated control vs 16-hour SARS-CoV-2 Spike peptide-pool-stimulated PBMCs from hospitalized severe COVID-19 patients (Gauting cohort)
fischer_2021.gex_vdj_accession: GEO GSE171037 (GSM5216975 GT6_unstim, GSM5216976 GT6_covid_stim, GSM5216977 GT_unstim, GSM5216978 GT_covid_stim: Cell Ranger 3 .h5 + .csv.gz + all_contig_annotations.json.gz)
fischer_2021.label_source: Experimental well assignment from GEO sample metadata (unstimulated control well vs autologous 16 h SARS-CoV-2 Spike overlapping peptide pool well) across persistent CDR3_beta clonotypes (>=2 CD3-gated T cells in both wells).
fischer_2021.experimental_assay: Ex vivo 16 h overlapping SARS-CoV-2 Spike peptide pool restimulation ('reverse phenotyping') vs parallel unstimulated PBMC control from the same blood draw.
fischer_2021.positive_definition: Persistent T-cell clones exhibiting paired within-clone effector cytokine transcript induction (delta mean log1p CP10K of IFNG, TNF, IL2, CCL4 > 0.5 and/or AIM/AIMBroad induction) upon Spike peptide stimulation.
fischer_2021.negative_definition: Persistent bystander T-cell clones present at >=2 cells in both unstimulated and Spike-stimulated wells showing no transcriptional cytokine/AIM induction.
fischer_2021.circularity_controls: None of TCRsift's signatures (AIM, AIMBroad, AcuteActivation, Differentiated, Cytolytic) were derived from GSE171037.
